releases.title: Customer ID expansion and currency code support
releases.requirement: Increase customerId capacity from 10 to 12 characters and introduce mandatory currencyCode support for ledger transactions.
dependencies: mq-bridge 3.1 emits LEDGREC rev 7 (25 bytes) and requires legacy-ledger >= 7.0 on LEDGER.IN.
legacy-ledger 7.0 accepts LEDGREC rev 6 and rev 7, so it must be deployed before mq-bridge 3.1.
legacy-ledger 7.0 requires ledger-db V15 (CUSTOMER_ID VARCHAR(12), CURRENCY_CODE).
payment-service 8.4 publishes orders-value v4; billing-service 7.2 must consume v4.
